Priya: Quick question for the Wed backend senior panel — can we lock down debrief ownership and rubric location? 1) Who runs the debrief? 2) Where do we store scores? 3) Any last-minute rubric clarifications?
Elena: I can run the debrief if that helps. PST here, so prefer doing it right after the interviews. :+1:
Samir Patel: I can take notes for the first two interviews (10:00–11:30 PT). For the 11:00 slot I might need a swap — heads up.
Maya K: Rubric is here: https://docs.internal/redwood/interviews/backend-senior-rubric — TL;DR: score 1-5 on Technical, System Design, Communication. Add 1–2 sentence evidence for any 1 or 5.
Priya: @Maya thanks — can we add a quick anchor for "systems: latency/cost tradeoffs" and a checkbox for quantization experience?
Maya K: done. Added an anchor under Systems -> "latency vs cost tradeoffs" and a small checkbox field for quantization/hardware familiarity. Also renamed "bonus" -> "notes" to avoid confusion.
Priya: Perfect. @Samir if you need to swap the 11:00, call it out here and I'll try to find cover. Also reminder: put candidate_id (not email) in the doc header like `candidate_id: 2023-453` so ops can reconcile.
Samir Patel: Can cover 11:00 if someone can move into my 10:15 window — @Elena think you could start 15m earlier?
Elena: I can shift to start 15m earlier, that's fine.
people-ops-bot: Created calendar event "Backend Sr interviews - debrief" (60m) scheduled 30m after last interview; video link included; invites: Priya, Elena, Samir Patel, Maya K.
Priya: Nice. Ops checklist: 1) capture scores in the rubric doc, 2) paste final hiring rec into #hiring-decisions with candidate_id, 3) note any regression flags under the "Quality concerns" section.
Maya K: Added a small scoring table template to the top of the rubric for quick copy/paste. Also included example phrasing for 5/1 for each dimension.
Elena: I'll run the debrief. @people-ops-bot can you enable recording for that event? :wave:
people-ops-bot: Recording scheduled for "Backend Sr interviews - debrief".
Priya: Thanks everyone — feels like we're set. If anyone gets delayed, ping here and we'll do coverage swaps. :thumbsup:
